name: Coda (now Superhuman Docs)
summary: All-in-one documents with tables and automations.

flows.title: Create a doc or a page
steps: To create a doc, click the new doc button on the workspace home.
To add a page to a doc, click the new page option in the sidebar on the left.

flows.title: Share a doc with someone
steps: Click the Share icon in the upper right corner of the doc.
Type the name or email address of the person to share with.
Choose their access level: Can view, Can comment or Can edit.

flows.title: Add a table
steps: In the doc, type /table, or use the insert panel in the top-right corner, to add a blank table.
To edit a column, right-click it and select Edit column.
